TicketWizard.avatar-subheading: Your look on the scavenger hunt leaderboard.
TicketWizard.avatar-body: Coming soon. We are still building this one, so carry on to your ticket and you can set your avatar later.
TicketWizard.intro-subheading: A quick, step-by-step process to get you to CUSEC 2027.
TicketWizard.intro-step-register-note: Sign up with the email you will use all conference. Your ticket links to it automatically.
TicketWizard.intro-step-demographics: Tell us a bit about yourself
TicketWizard.intro-step-demographics-note: A short survey about you and how you are getting to Montreal. Kept confidential.
TicketWizard.intro-step-avatar-note: Pick the look that represents you on the scavenger hunt leaderboard.
TicketWizard.intro-step-purchase-note: Checkout happens right here on our site. Buy with the same email and you are done.
TicketWizard.intro-complete-subheading: Your ticket is confirmed and your account is linked.
TicketWizard.confidential-notice: This information is confidential and will not be shared with anyone outside the CUSEC organizing team.
TicketWizard.field-head-delegate: Does your school have a Head Delegate (HD)?
TicketWizard.travel-discount-note: We're lining up travel discounts with airlines — and hopefully hotels. Tell us how you're getting here and we'll email you the ones that apply to you.
TicketWizard.field-travel-from-hint: City and province or country, e.g. Halifax, NS
TicketWizard.field-travel-method: How are you getting to Montréal?
TicketWizard.field-how-did-you-hear: How did you hear about CUSEC?
TicketWizard.field-excited-events: Pick 3 events you would be most excited for
TicketWizard.field-why-attend: Why do you want to attend CUSEC 2027?
TicketWizard.field-school-involvement: Tell us about your involvement in your school community
TicketWizard.field-cusec-association: When I think of CUSEC, I think of...
TicketWizard.error-generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
TicketWizard.purchase-subheading: Last step! Pick a ticket to finish your registration.
TicketWizard.purchase-one-per-person: One ticket per delegate. Each person buys their own with their own CUSEC account, so keep the email as {email} at checkout and your ticket links on its own.
TicketWizard.mock-banner: Showing test data — connect Ticket Tailor to go live.

TicketWizard.purchase-already-complete: Your ticket is confirmed — you're all set!
TicketWizard.purchase-already-complete-named: Your {ticket} is confirmed — you're all set!
TicketWizard.purchase-fallback-manual-link: Still processing? Check your email, or link your ticket email manually from your scavenger hunt dashboard once it arrives.
TicketWizard.purchase-continue-checkout: Trouble checking out? Continue to checkout — we'll bring you straight back.
TicketWizard.purchase-verifying: Confirming your purchase with Ticket Tailor…

TicketWizard.purchase-claim-error-no-order: No completed CUSEC 2027 order found for that email.

TicketWizard.purchase-claim-error-invalid: Please enter a valid email address.

TicketWizard.already-collected-notice: We already have your name, email, school and degree from checkout — this is just the rest.
